WHEREAS, THE CLERK FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA,HAS PREPARED AND SUBMITTED TO THE GOVERNING AUTHORITY, A BUDGET PROPOSAL FOR THE FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 01,2006 AND ENDING JUNE 30,2007; AND

WHEREAS, THE TOWN COUNCIL OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA HAS STUDIED AND REVISED THE PROPOSED BUDGET, AND DOES HEREBY CONSIDER IT TO BE IN THE BEST INTEREST OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT TO APPROE THE BUDGET AS PROPOSED.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLOVED BY THE TOWN COUNCIL FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, DULY ASSEMBLED AND BY UNANIMOUS VOTE THEREOF, THAT THE BUDGET ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF FOR THE YEAR BEGINNING JULY 01, 2006 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2007, IS

ADOPTED. ad Ze Ud AMES NIX, MAYOR

ATTEST: A onava dH ebton
